= Label cypher injection

== should escape the label name passed in context

.Schema
[source,graphql,schema=true]
----
type Movie @node(labels: ["$context.label"]) {
  title: String
}
----

.GraphQL-Query
[source,graphql,request=true]
----
{
  movies {
    title
  }
}
----

.Query Context
[source,json,query-config=true]
----
{
  "contextParams": {
    "label": "Movie\\u0060) MATCH"
  }
}
----

.Expected Cypher params
[source,json]
----
{}
----

.Expected Cypher output
[source,cypher]
----
MATCH (this:`Movie``) MATCH`)
RETURN this { .title } AS this
----

.GraphQL-Response
[source,json,response=true]
----
{
  "movies": []
}
----
